tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches a free library of AI video prompts that really worked, each published next to the video it produced. Takes a plain-language description of a video (subject, mood, style, shot) in any language; English gives the closest matches. Returns the prompts that fit, best first, each with how well it

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns one prompt in full, from an id given by search or the address of a prompt page: the original text that produced the video, its translation when there is one, the blanks to fill, the model, the video and the credit of its creator.

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Lists what search can filter on: the video models the library covers, its categories and its camera, light and style techniques.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
